mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nc_service (name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{at}, #{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at FROM nc_service WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at FROM nc_service ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nc_instance (service_name, instance_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{serviceName}, #{instanceId}, #{at}, #{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT service_name, instance_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at FROM nc_instance WHERE service_name = #{serviceName} ORDER BY instance_id
